title: Experts disagree on new paqad-ai managed-settings
context:
Chief architect: This is the acceptance claim that can be checked. The product-owner outcome (one file turns the block on everywhere and a developer cannot loosen it) is the same intent. Whether a local off switch loosens it is asked as an owner question.

Target: new paqad-ai managed-settings
- product-owner: the Operator who runs a team can print and write one managed settings file that turns on the edit-time rule block on every machine, and a Developer cannot loosen it locally
- qa-engineer: given enterprise.enabled is false, then it exits 1 with the exact message and writes no file; with enterprise on, output parses as JSON, `--write` creates `<dir>/paqad.json` only, `--no-plugin` drops exactly the two plugin keys, and a repo-wide test asserts zero `Eliyce/paqad-plugin` references remain (D-b); proof_type unit
